tex_content.label: THM
tex_content.html:
Fix $\bar\tau _0,l_0,V>0$. There is $\kappa =\kappa (\bar\tau _0,V,l_0,n)>0$ with the following property. Let $({\mathcal M},G)$ be a generalized $n$-dimensional Ricci flow, fix $x\in {\mathcal M}$ with ${\bf t}(x)=T$, and suppose $0<\tau _0\leq \bar\tau _0$ and $0<r\leq \sqrt{\tau _0}$. Assume:

  1. $B(x,T,r)\subset M_T$ has compact closure;

  2. there is an embedding $B(x,T,r)\times [T-r^2,T]\subset {\mathcal M}$ compatible with time and the time vector field;

  3. $|\Rm |\leq r^{-2}$ on this parabolic neighborhood;

  4. an open set $\widetilde W\subset \widetilde{\mathcal U}_x(\tau _0)\subset T_xM_T$ has the property that every associated $\mathcal L$-geodesic on $[0,\tau _0]$ has reduced length at most $l_0$;

  5. for $W(\tau )={\mathcal L}\operatorname {exp}_x^\tau (\widetilde W)$, $\Vol W(\tau _0)\geq V$.

Then \[ \Vol B(x,T,r)\geq \kappa r^n. \]
